narr: Isolated to scattered thunderstorms occurred through mid evening across the mountains, mountain valleys, and locations along and west of I-25. The severe threat was low, though a stronger storm or two did occur. An isolated flash flooding threat was also noted on this day, and did occur with the Spring Burn Scar observing heavy rainfall and flash flooding.
ev: Debris and mudflow were noted into Middle Creek and along county roads 440 and 442.
One to three feet of water and mud over county road 162.
lsr: 1-3 FEET OF WATER AND MUD OVER COUNTY ROAD 162. LOCATION IS APPROXIMATED.
LOTS OF DEBRIS AND MUDFLOWS INTO MIDDLE CREEK ALONG CR 440 AND CR 442 PER HUERFANO COUNTY OFFICIALS.
